name: aa-probe
description: agent-archive probe: records which hooks fire in cloud sessions, whether plugin options and a bundled binary reach them. Writes markers to /tmp only.

upload_note.title: Probe note
upload_note.description: Any non-secret text, for example hello. Tests whether plain options reach cloud hooks.

upload_secret.title: Probe secret
upload_secret.description: Type the test value probe-secret-123 (not a real secret). Tests whether sensitive options reach cloud hooks.
